description: Examinations dated on either end date are counted together with those dated in between.

b.request: Select examination records whose `Examination Date`, compared as text, falls from `1995-11-09` through `1997-03-17` inclusive; return one row with the unrounded average of non-null `ANA` values first and the count of all selected examination records second.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA), COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE CAST(`Examination Date` AS TEXT) BETWEEN '1995-11-09' AND '1997-03-17';
b.raw: Select examination records whose `Examination Date`, compared as text, falls from `1995-11-09` through `1997-03-17` inclusive; return one row with the unrounded average of non-null `ANA` values first and the count of all selected examination records second.

d.request: Among examination records whose `Examination Date`, compared as text, is from `1995-11-09` through `1997-03-17` inclusive, return one row containing the unrounded average of non-null `ANA` values first and the total number of examination records second.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA), COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE CAST(`Examination Date` AS TEXT) BETWEEN '1995-11-09' AND '1997-03-17'

a.request: Looking at examinations with an `Examination Date` on or after 1995-11-09 and on or before 1997-03-17 (comparing the dates as text), what is the average `ANA` value (ignoring missing values) and how many examination records are there in total? Give the answer as a single row with the unrounded average first and the record count second.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA), COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` >= '1995-11-09' AND `Examination Date` <= '1997-03-17'

c.request: For examinations held between 1995-11-09 and 1997-03-17 (comparing the `Examination Date` as text), what is the average `ANA` value (ignoring missing values) and how many examination records are there in total? Give one row with the unrounded average first and the record count second. Examinations dated on either end date are counted together with those dated in between.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(ANA), COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE CAST(`Examination Date` AS TEXT) BETWEEN '1995-11-09' AND '1997-03-17';
